registers.name: ID
registers.description: GBES identity.

registers.name: ABI
registers.description: CPU overlay independent alpha/ink ABI.

registers.name: CAP
registers.description: 7 always; OR 216 when both CPU overlay and overlay AXIS enabled. Driver checks aggregate optional mask 0xD8; no invented individual bit names.

registers.name: CLOCK
registers.description: Required service clock Hz; RTL constant, not frequency measurement.

registers.name: DIAG_CONTROL
registers.description: Selector[4:0]; changing bit8 injects diagnostic event. Byte strobes honored. Do not write for ordinary monitoring.

registers.name: STATUS
registers.description: Bit0 ESP IRQ request, bit1 CPU pending, bit2 registered CPU IRQ.

registers.name: DIAG_DATA
registers.description: Selected endpoint diagnostic word, sampled non-atomically.

registers.name: BUTTONS
registers.description: Pressed-high host bitmap[11:0], reverse of native input bit order.

registers.name: PENDING
registers.description: Bit0 independent CPU change latch. Press/release sets; event wins simultaneous clear.

registers.name: IRQ_ENABLE
registers.description: Bit0 enables CPU level IRQ. Does not gate ESP IRQ.

registers.name: GATE_ID
registers.description: GBIR identity.

registers.name: GATE_MANUAL
registers.description: Manual assertion bit0 only if C_MANUAL_OVERRIDE; otherwise write SLVERR.

registers.name: GATE_STATUS
registers.description: Bit0 request, bit1 synchronized request, bit2 actual gate assertion.

registers.name: GATE_CAP
registers.description: C_MANUAL_OVERRIDE value.

registers.name: GATE_ABI
registers.description: IRQ gate ABI.

registers.name: DIAG_BANK
registers.description: 16 aligned words 0x100..0x13c, diagnostic selectors0..15; snapshots not atomic.

registers.name: OVERLAY_ENABLE
registers.description: Bit0 CPU layer enable; writes SLVERR when optional layer absent.

registers.name: WORD_INDEX
registers.description: 0..5759, full strobe required. Auto increments and wraps after word data writes.

registers.name: WORD_DATA
registers.description: Write16 2-bit pixels LSB-first; each byte strobe enables4 pixels. Read returns last written bus word, NOT framebuffer readback.

registers.name: DIMENSIONS
registers.description: Height240 upper16, width384 lower16 (also returned when absent).

registers.name: WORD_WRITES
registers.description: Accepted nonzero-strobe packed writes counter.

registers.name: OVERLAY_ID
registers.description: 0x434f5632 COV2 when optional layer enabled; zero otherwise.

registers.name: PIXEL_BITS
registers.description: Bits per pixel {opaque,white}.

registers.name: WORD_COUNT
registers.description: Packed bitmap word count.

registers.name: PIXEL_INDEX
registers.description: 0..92159, full strobe required. Row-major logical coordinate y*384+x.

registers.name: PIXEL_DATA
registers.description: Low2 bits write one pixel if byte0 strobe. Read SLVERR; index auto increments/wraps.

registers.name: PIXEL_WRITES
registers.description: Accepted single pixel writes counter.

registers.name: PIXEL_COUNT
registers.description: Logical pixel count.
